item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning negative. I found repeated signs of strategic framing in high-stakes situations, especially the disputed election and the term-limit/constitutional-reform question. There is also some corroborated diplomacy and macro-stabilization messaging, but not enough to support a general claim that Tshisekedi habitually told the truth across audiences when deception would have helped him.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Congolese President Tshisekedi sworn in for second term after disputed vote](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/congolese-president-tshisekedi-sworn-in-for-second-term-after-disputed-vote-3278886) | Reuters | 2024-01-20 | Tshisekedi entered office after a landslide win that opponents refused to recognize because of widespread irregularities. This is strong negative evidence for candor on a power-protecting issue: his legitimacy claim was publicly contested from the start. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.8, 6B.9
- [DR Congo court confirms President Tshisekedi's re-election](https://theprint.in/world/dr-congo-court-confirms-president-tshisekedis-re-election/1917214/) | Reuters | 2024-01-10 | The court upheld the result despite observers’ reports of widespread irregularities, while main opposition figures said they did not trust the court. This does not prove a lie by itself, but it reinforces that his victory narrative rested on a deeply disputed process. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.9
- [Congo’s election commission cancels 82 candidates in disputed December polling](https://theprint.in/world/congos-election-commission-cancels-82-candidates-in-disputed-december-polling/1913556/) | Reuters | 2024-01-07 | CENI invalidated dozens of candidacies amid fraud allegations while the presidential result remained disputed. The opacity around the election process is negative evidence for transparent public truth-telling when power was at stake. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.9
- [Congo election commission overspent, awarded opaque contracts report](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-election-commission-overspent-awarded-opaque-contracts-report-2024-01-15/) | Reuters | 2024-01-15 | Reuters reported a civil-society report saying CENI could not account for about $400 million and used opaque procurement. That is indirect but concrete evidence of non-transparent handling of a major public process surrounding Tshisekedi’s election. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.9
- [Congo President Tshisekedi draws criticism over constitutional reform plans](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/) | Reuters | 2024-10-24 | Tshisekedi said a commission would study constitutional revisions because the current text did not fit current realities, but critics said it could remove term limits and enable a third term. This is strong evidence of potentially misleading framing where self-entrenchment would be helped by ambiguity. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.9
- [Congo opposition calls for protests against plans to reform constitution](https://www.yahoo.com/news/congo-opposition-calls-protests-against-162930970.html) | Reuters | 2024-11-20 | Opposition leaders warned the reform push was a tactic to keep Tshisekedi in office, while the communications minister asked people not to question his intentions. That is not proof of deceit, but it is strong evidence that his public framing was widely treated as disingenuous. | IDs: 7B.1, 4B.1, 6B.9
- [Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say](https://d2233.cms.socastsrm.com/2024/07/04/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/) | Reuters | 2024-07-04 | Reuters reported Tshisekedi threatened war against Rwanda while the army relied on pro-government militias and suffered weak discipline. That combination suggests escalatory rhetoric and selective candor about actual control and capacity. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.3, 6B.6, 6B.7
- [Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E. Mr. Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo](https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french) | UN Secretary-General | 2024-09-24 | The UN independently confirmed that Tshisekedi discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts. This is positive evidence that at least some of his public diplomacy was consistent with external readouts rather than pure performance. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.3, 6B.6
- [Collective effort essential to get DR Congo on firm path to peace](https://www.ungeneva.org/en/news-media/news/2024/09/98156/collective-effort-essential-get-dr-congo-firm-path-to-peace) | UN Office at Geneva | 2024-09-30 | The UN said fighting had decreased after the 30 July ceasefire and a dialogue framework was active. That modestly supports Tshisekedi’s public ceasefire posture as something more than empty rhetoric, though the broader situation stayed fragile. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.3, 6B.6
- [IMF Executive Board Completes the Sixth Review Under the ECF Arrangement for the Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr) | IMF | 2024-07-03 | The IMF reported prudent macro policies, reserve build-up, inflation easing, and some revenue mobilization progress. That gives partial support to the presidency’s stabilization narrative, but the same IMF reporting also says reforms were slow and fiscal foundations remained weak. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.10, 6B.9
- [DR Congo president appoints country’s first female prime minister](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/) | Reuters | 2024-04-01 | The appointment of Judith Suminwa, a technocratic planning minister, was a real inclusion move rather than mere rhetoric. It is only mild positive evidence, but it shows at least one public reform claim was matched by action. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.8, 6B.9, 6B.7
- [DR Congo president must use second term to tackle human rights crisis](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/) | Amnesty International | 2024-06-24 | Amnesty said there had been little to no progress on prior pledges, while public resources were squandered and essential services remained underfunded. This is strong counterevidence that Tshisekedi was being candid about governance performance when truth would have protected his reputation. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.8, 6B.9, 6B.10
- [DR Congo president must be held accountable for human rights violations](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/) | Amnesty International | 2024-09-30 | Amnesty said the state of siege militarized daily life, humanitarian needs stayed underfunded, and sexual violence and attacks on civilians were not being prevented or punished. This strongly contradicts any consistently truthful public narrative about civilian protection and rule-of-law performance. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.8, 6B.9, 6B.6, 6B.7
- [Human Rights Watch: Democratic Republic of Congo world report chapter](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW said repression, arbitrary arrests, police violence, and weak systemic reform continued through 2024. That is broad negative evidence against a candid, accountability-oriented public posture, especially where admitting failure would have hurt power. | IDs: 7B.1, 6B.8, 6B.9, 6B.7

**Search Gap**
I did not find direct transcript-level proof that Tshisekedi lied to the legislature or courts in a way that can be cleanly proven from public sources. The evidence is mostly indirect: disputed election claims, third-term/constitutional-reform framing, escalatory war rhetoric, and independent reports that contradicted or undercut the government’s public narrative. The safest read is selective truthfulness and strategic framing, not a proven always-lies or always-truths pattern.
